name: @polymech/pm-encryption
description: Standalone E2EE library and pm-encryption CLI. The library links no sibling. The CLI links vfs.cpp for the group-file scenario.

scripts.build:cpp: npm run configure && node scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset dev --target pm-encryption
scripts.build:cpp:release: npm run configure:release && node scripts/cmake.mjs --build --preset release --target pm-encryption
